idea: On his early round a postman walks past a row of dark windows; one lights up, a child waves, and he waves back
leave: A small hello is what makes the round worth walking
subject: the windows along the street

device.what: one window lighting up warm in a row of cold dark ones
device.why: the light is the child: it turns the street from empty to someone there

change.from: an early street, every window dark
change.to: the postman has walked in along the dark windows

change.from: the window beside him is dark
change.to: it has lit up and a child stands in it
he has waved back and the words 早安 have appeared
